title: After refreshing the FlatList, always set the contentOffset to 0

labels.name: Resolution: Locked
labels.description: This issue was locked by the bot.

body:
## 🐛 Bug Report
<!--
  A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
  Include screenshots if needed.
-->
I'm using the `FlatList` with `contentInset` and `contentOffset` prop to guarantee the content doesn't be hidden by header things. However, if I invoke some pull-to-refresh on the `FlatList`, `contentOffset` always goes to 0 after refreshing is finished. I think `contentOffset` should not be always zero if `contentInset` is already set. 

I think that this might be the same as #20610 and I tested this is reproduced on the latest RN version.

## To Reproduce
<!--
  Steps to reproduce the behavior.
-->
In the `RNTester/js/FlatListExample.js, I added some code for `refreshing`, `contnetInset`, `contentOffset` like below.

```
  [...] 
  componentDidMount() {
    // To make refreshing, I set the refreshing to be true right after componentDidMount
    // and set to false again after 3 secs
    this.setState({ refreshing: true });
    setTimeout(() => this.setState({ refreshing: false }), 3000);
  }
  [...]
  render() {
        [...]          
        <Animated.FlatList
           [...]
            contentInset={{ top: 50 }}
            contentOffset={{ y: -50 }}
            refreshing={this.state.refreshing} 
        />
  }
[...]
```
## Expected Behavior
<!--
  A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
-->
Here's a screenshot when I only set the `contentInset` and `contentOffset` and didn't call refreshing(just gave `refreshing` prop as `false`). I drew a red box which indicates `contentInset` and `contentOffset` works well. 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12604726/55090591-bf1a7280-50f2-11e9-8f90-d80e6b5b5a47.png)

In this case, I think after refreshing that the same `contentOffset` should be maintained. However, `contentOffset` always goes to 0 as shown in below gif.
![Mar-28-2019 00-49-09](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12604726/55090954-5384d500-50f3-11e9-8383-223187a0a2dd.gif)
